consonant_ms.source: median(est_cluster_dur_ms/cluster_len) over n=71 v0 rows (V0 raw '*-chunks' lane, clean subset)

stress_ratio.source: median(content per-syl dur)/median(function per-syl dur), gold line, n_content=4 n_function=2

function_compress.source: median(function per-syl dur)/median(content per-syl dur), gold line, n_content=4 n_function=2

final_lengthen.source: final-word per-syl dur / median(other words' per-syl dur), gold line (n_others=5)

floor_ms.source: min(gold word slot duration ms) over n=6 words

floor_per_consonant_ms.source: default (no measurement defined for this coefficient)
